function label<T extends new (...args: any[]) => any>(Base: T) {
  return class extends Base { label = "item"; };
}
class Item { value = 1; }
const LabeledItem = label(Item);
const item = new LabeledItem();
console.log(item.value.toFixed(1), item.label);

function fromNumber<T extends new (...args: any[]) => { value: number }>(Base: T) {
  return class NamedMixin extends Base {
    get doubled(): number { return this.value * 2; }
  };
}
class Named {
  static prefix = "entry";
  value = 3;
  name = "named";
}
const LabeledNamed = fromNumber(Named);
console.log(LabeledNamed.prefix, new LabeledNamed().name, new LabeledNamed().doubled);

function addCount<T extends new (...args: any[]) => object>(Base: T) {
  class Counted extends label(Base) { count = 2; }
  return Counted;
}
class Box<T> { constructor(public value: T) {} }
const CountedBox = addCount(Box);
const box = new CountedBox("text");
console.log(box.value.toUpperCase(), box.label, box.count.toFixed(1));
